Student life

Your student life at the African Business School (ABS) in Bamako

In the heart of Hamdallaye ACI 2000, the African Business School (ABS) offers far more than excellent training: a living campus, an elected student government, sport integrated into every curriculum and an engaged community.

Student government: the BAGE

Get involved, decide, build

At the African Business School (ABS), students are not spectators: they are actors. Associations, thematic clubs and solidarity projects shape the year and develop creativity, responsibility and teamwork.

The BAGE, your voice

The Students' General Assembly is the student government of the African Business School (ABS), democratically elected every year. It represents your interests with the administration and organises campus life.

Discover

Thematic clubs

Entrepreneurship, culture, media, environment, digital technology: join an existing club or create your own with the support of the BAGE and the administration.

Discover

Civic engagement

Mentoring high-school students, volunteer work, campus recycling campaigns: responsibility and openness are among the values we live every day.

Discover

A healthy body for a high-performing mind

Sport and physical activities are integrated into the curricula of all our Bachelor's and Master's programmes. Competition, recreation or fitness: everyone finds their place and builds team spirit.

Sport integrated into the curricula

Sport is part of every student's timetable: football, basketball, athletics and fitness. Because physical well-being supports academic success.

Discover

Inter-class tournaments

The major sporting events of the year unite the classes: football championship, basketball tournaments and athletics days on the Hamdallaye campus.

Discover

Mental well-being

Listening, support and prevention: our support team watches over the balance between student life, the intensity of the curricula and personal life.

Discover

A year full of highlights

From the start of the academic year to the annual gala, the BAGE and the University's teams organise more than 10 events per year: culture, entrepreneurship, sport and openness to Africa.

Open days

Introduce the African Business School (ABS) to your family and friends and meet the teaching teams.

Discover

Entrepreneurship week

Workshops, pitches and meetings with Malian and pan-African entrepreneurs.

Discover

Annual ABS gala

The great gathering of the community: awards ceremony, culture and celebration.

Discover
Full events calendar

Succeeding together

Career coaching, health, tutoring: our services support every student from enrolment through to professional integration.

Coaching & employability

Every student benefits from personalised support: career plan, interview preparation, internships and networking with partner companies.

Discover

Health & services

Health guidance, administrative services and everyday support so you can study with peace of mind.

Discover

Academic support

Peer tutoring between classes, access to the library and the e-campus platform: no one is left alone to face the demands of the programme.

Discover
Student engagement

The BAGE: an elected student government

The Students' General Assembly (BAGE) is democratically elected every year. Its board sits at the heart of student life: it champions your ideas, negotiates campus improvements and co-builds the events calendar with the General Management.

  • Represent students with the administration
  • Run the campus clubs and associations
  • Organise the major events of the year
  • Lead CSR projects: mentoring, volunteering, recycling
Join an association

Coaching & internships

Individual support towards employment: CV, mock interviews and internships with partner companies from the Bachelor's level onward.

Professional network

Career forums, meetings with alumni, and Malian and pan-African companies that recruit directly on campus.

Responsibility & CSR

Mentoring young people, volunteering and recycling: our students are committed to the sustainable development of Mali and Africa.

Ready to experience the ABS journey?

Join a university where academic excellence, practice and campus life move forward together, in the heart of Bamako.
